name: Hatsune
source:
A young serving girl at the brothel ”Yukishiro” where Shuugo rents a room. 

Circumstances have left her with no relatives, and she’s been living at the Yukishiro since she was very young. 

Despite her fragile appearance, since she’s been working with adults for a long time, she has a very levelheaded personality. 

She’s quite attached to Shuugo and brings him his meals morning and night, practically waiting on him hand and foot.

[From [url=http://www.mangagamer.com/detail.php?goods_type=1&product_code=116]MangaGamer[/url]]
